welcome.title: Welcome to {{brand}}
welcome.body: Use USDT to make predictions. Two steps to get started:
items: Deposit USDT (your balance updates when it arrives)
Verify your identity (about 3 minutes; required before withdrawing)
welcome.note: You can open this guide again from Me → Getting started.

kyc.title: Step 1: verify your identity
kyc.body: Upload photos of your ID. Your name and date of birth must match it. Reviews usually finish within one business day; the result is sent to your inbox and email.
items: Both sides of your ID card, or the photo page of your passport
kyc.note: Identity verification is required before withdrawing.

deposit.title: Step 2: deposit USDT
deposit.body: Go to Assets → Deposit, choose a network, copy your own address and send USDT from an exchange or wallet.
items: Ethereum (ERC20), TRON (TRC20) and BNB Chain are supported
Your balance updates automatically and you get a notification
deposit.note: Send USDT only, on the same network as the address. Wrong coins or networks cannot be recovered.

home.title: Prediction markets
home.body: Markets, betting and settlement are coming in later steps. You can deposit and verify your identity now.
